review.rationale: The Decision preserves the R4 failure reference and SHA-256, binds exact stdout bytes (hex 6469676974616c2d62696f7370686572652d6172636869746563747572652f0a, UTF-8 escaped digital-biosphere-architecture/\n, SHA-256 996e96d716cc85b64b8dd5cb6026feaa74526628dd7d28531ba4af2d121f52e4), requires empty stderr, exactly one line, and exactly one terminal LF. Logical prefix derivation is strictly REMOVE_EXACTLY_ONE_ALREADY_VALIDATED_TERMINAL_LF with strip/rstrip/CRLF/extra lines/whitespace/NUL forbidden. Local/remote HEAD equality is required; the exact five target paths are enumerated and bound via EXACT_ORDERED_UTF8_PATH_SET with no basename/suffix/substring/absolute normalization. The frozen patch SHA-256 is bound and patch_change_authorized is false. The inherited semantic false-key contract is referenced. The validation bundle is single-process fail-closed with commit/push gated on all checks passing. All operational, commercial, and authority effects remain unauthorized, and no prior failure reclassification is permitted.
